item.text: {"decisions": [{"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0001", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0001 is the CIDOB page header, institutional navigation menu, and basic identity block. It contains only mandate dates, political affiliation, succession metadata, and publisher institutional text. It does not describe any legislative agenda, policy execution, budget allocation, economic appointments, fiscal rules, competition enforcement, anti-corruption activity, infrastructure delivery, economic information practices, distributional outcomes, shock response, or economic trajectory for the 2018-2024 presidency. No economic policy content is present.", "exclusion_reason": "Identity, mandate, and institutional metadata block. No economic policy content for any Chapter 5B question. Header/navigation content is structurally excluded from evidence routing."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0002", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.1", "5B.7", "5B.9"], "relevance_strength": "pivotal", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0003", "unit-0004", "unit-0005", "unit-0006", "unit-0007", "unit-0062", "unit-0063"], "explanation": "Unit-0002 is the political overview section covering rise, electoral history, and 2018 victory context. It contains the programmatic platform themes: macroeconomic stability commitment, rejection of neoliberalism, social programs, austerity, anti-corruption promise, Guardia Nacional, migration, and relationship with Trump. These directly activate 5B.1 (legislative/policy agenda orientation), 5B.7 (economic information and promise framing), and 5B.9 (shock response context including trade/Trump shocks). The section explicitly characterizes the 2018 platform as pragmatic social democracy assuming orthodox free-market principles with macroeconomic discipline.", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0003", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0003 is the chapter index / table of contents for the biography. It lists chronological chapter headings but contains no substantive economic policy content, no description of policy execution, no budget data, no appointments, no fiscal rule compliance, no enforcement actions, no infrastructure delivery, no distributional evidence, no shock-response measures, and no economic trajectory assessment.", "exclusion_reason": "Chapter index / table of contents. No substantive content, only structural headings. No economic policy information for any Chapter 5B question."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0004", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.5", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "material", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0005", "unit-0011", "unit-0012", "unit-0013"], "explanation": "Unit-0004 covers the 1988 electoral fraud claim, Democratic Current, PRD founding, and FOBAPROA context. FOBAPROA was a state instrument created under Salinas that rescued bank losses for connected businessmen by converting their debt to public liability. López Obrador publicly characterized this as the 'biggest fraud in history after the Conquest' and investigated/published findings on it. This is directly relevant to 5B.5 (anti-corruption enforcement against politically connected actors; cooperation with audits/courts) and 5B.7 (reliable economic information publication; willingness to expose institutional failure).", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0005", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.5", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "material", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0004", "unit-0014", "unit-0015", "unit-0016"], "explanation": "Unit-0005 covers PRD presidency (1996-1999), electoral mobilization, 1997 DF elections, departure from PRD leadership, and FOBAPROA investigation continuation. The FOBAPROA investigation and López Obrador's public denunciation of the mechanism as unconstitutional and fraudulent is again central here, reinforcing 5B.5 and 5B.7 relevance. The 1997 DF election victory is also mentioned, establishing context for later DF government.", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0006", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.1", "5B.2", "5B.6", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "pivotal", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0007", "unit-0018", "unit-0019", "unit-0020", "unit-0021"], "explanation": "Unit-0006 is the central DF government management section covering social programs (Pensión Universal Alimenticia), public works, transparency and accountability, popularity, mañaneras press conferences, and DF financial management. This covers 5B.1 (budget orientation toward social welfare vs patronage), 5B.2 (appointments and operational independence), 5B.6 (budgets producing social programs and infrastructure), and 5B.7 (transparency and accountability practices, mañaneras as information channel). The video scandal context is also introduced, relevant to 5B.5.", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0007", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.5", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "pivotal", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0006", "unit-0022", "unit-0023", "unit-0024", "unit-0025"], "explanation": "Unit-0007 covers the video scandal (2004), corruption allegations, desafuero process (2005), and mobilization in defense of immunity. Carlos Ahumada Kurtz was the businessman at the center of the scandal involving PRD officials including René Bejarano. López Obrador's response was characterized as political counterattack rather than clean condemnation, and the desafuero process is described in detail. This is directly relevant to 5B.5 (anti-corruption enforcement against politically connected actors; cooperation with courts) and 5B.7 (reliable information vs political counterattack framing).", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0008", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.5", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "pivotal", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0007", "unit-0028", "unit-0029", "unit-0030", "unit-0031", "unit-0032", "unit-0033", "unit-0034", "unit-0035", "unit-0036", "unit-0037"], "explanation": "Unit-0008 covers the 2006 presidential campaign, close election results, electoral dispute, 'legitimate presidency' claim, civil disobedience, and TEPJF ruling. This chunk introduces the post-electoral dispute and civil disobedience strategy, the 'legitimate presidency' parallel government, and the broader pattern of electoral contestation that frames López Obrador's approach to institutional compliance vs extra-institutional mobilization — relevant to 5B.5 and 5B.7, and to 5B.3 in terms of rule compliance.", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0009", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0009 covers López Obrador's early life, family background, UNAM studies, PRI entry, and political formation (1953-1970s). This is biographical background material predating any governance role. It contains no economic policy content relevant to any Chapter 5B question. No budget decisions, no appointments, no fiscal rules, no enforcement, no infrastructure delivery, no distributional evidence, no shock response.", "exclusion_reason": "Early biographical material (1953-1970s). No governance, no economic policy content for any Chapter 5B question. Pre-governance background only."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0010", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0010 covers López Obrador's career as a PRI functionary in Tabasco, INI delegation, COPLAMAR work, teaching at Universidad Autónoma de Tabasco, marriage, and children. This is pre-governance career development material. No Chapter 5B economic policy content is present. No policy execution, no budget decisions, no appointments of economic professionals, no fiscal rule compliance.", "exclusion_reason": "Pre-governance career development (1970s-1982). No economic policy content for any Chapter 5B question. Functionary period before any public office with economic management authority."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0011", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0011 covers López Obrador's PRI party work in Tabasco, his book publications on Tabasco history, UNAM graduation, and the formation of the Corriente Democrática (1987). No economic governance content. The Corriente Democrática formation and its ideological basis are described, but no policy execution, budget decisions, fiscal rules, appointments, or economic enforcement actions are described for this period.", "exclusion_reason": "Corriente Democrática formation period (1987). No executive economic governance content. Party political formation, not economic policy execution."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0012", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.5", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "material", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0011", "unit-0013"], "explanation": "Unit-0012 covers the 1988 electoral fraud claims at both the presidential (Cárdenas) and gubernatorial (López Obrador Tabasco) levels. López Obrador documented irregularities including expulsion of FDN representatives from polling stations and destruction of ballots. His 1990 book 'Tabasco, víctima del fraude' analyzed the elections. This is relevant to 5B.5 (institutional compliance; cooperation with electoral courts vs extra-institutional claims) and 5B.7 (publication of reliable information vs political narrative).", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0013", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0013 covers the PRD founding (May 1989), the 1991-1992 democratic exodus march, and the resolution of municipal election disputes in Tabasco and Veracruz. The content describes party formation and civic mobilization. No executive economic governance content for any Chapter 5B question. No policy execution, no budget decisions, no fiscal rule compliance, no enforcement actions.", "exclusion_reason": "PRD founding (1989) and civic mobilization. No executive economic governance. Party formation and protest activities, not economic policy execution."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0014", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0014 covers the 1994 gubernatorial election in Tabasco, López Obrador's defeat to Roberto Madrazo, his electoral protest, complaint to PGR about campaign spending violations, and the 1995 Caravana por la Democracia. The content is about electoral contestation. No executive economic governance content for Chapter 5B. While the FOBAPROA and oil sovereignty are mentioned, they are referenced in the context of the 1995 Alianzade Democratic protest, not as policy execution.", "exclusion_reason": "1994 Tabasco gubernatorial electoral contestation and post-election mobilization. No executive economic governance. Electoral opposition period, not governing economic policy execution."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0015", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0015 covers PRD internal party disputes, the 1996 PRD presidency election, and López Obrador's ascendancy to party leadership. No executive economic governance content. The content describes party organizational politics and ideological positioning. No policy execution, no budget decisions, no fiscal rules, no appointments, no enforcement.", "exclusion_reason": "PRD party presidency (1996). No executive economic governance. Party organizational politics, not governing economic policy."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0016", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0016 covers the 1997 DF elections, Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas's victory as first elected DF head, PRD legislative gains, PRD state gubernatorial victories (1998-1999), and the 1999 PRD internal election chaos leading to López Obrador's departure. This is electoral and party organizational content. No executive economic governance content for Chapter 5B.", "exclusion_reason": "1997-1999 electoral results and party organizational content. No executive economic governance. Electoral outcomes and party internal disputes, not governing policy execution."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0017", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0017 covers López Obrador's resignation from PRD leadership (September 1999), his publication of FOBAPROA investigation findings in a new book-denounce, and transition to DF government. The FOBAPROA content is summarized but the detailed findings are already covered in units 0004-0005. The transitional context does not add new Chapter 5B economic governance content beyond what is already in adjacent chunks.", "exclusion_reason": "Transition period content already covered in adjacent chunks (FOBAPROA findings summarized; DF government begins in unit-0018). No substantive new Chapter 5B economic governance content."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0018", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.1", "5B.2", "5B.6", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "pivotal", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0017", "unit-0019", "unit-0020", "unit-0021"], "explanation": "Unit-0018 covers López Obrador's DF mayoral primary victory (November 1999), the July 2000 general election where he won DF government, and the coalition that supported him. This establishes the beginning of his executive governance of the DF (2000-2005), which is covered in detail in subsequent units. The coalition composition and electoral mandate context are relevant to 5B.1 and 5B.7.", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0019", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.1", "5B.2", "5B.6", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "pivotal", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0018", "unit-0020", "unit-0021", "unit-0022"], "explanation": "Unit-0019 covers the beginning of López Obrador's DF government mandate (December 2000), the deaths of both his parents and his wife (2000-2003), and a detailed evaluation of his governance approach from 2000-2005. It describes him as a 'regidor voluntarioso y esforzado,' 'sincere,' socially committed, austere, and committed to regular accountability, transparency, and participatory democracy. These characterizations are relevant to 5B.1 (orientation toward social welfare vs rents), 5B.2 (accountability approach), 5B.6 (social program delivery), and 5B.7 (transparency commitment).", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0020", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.1", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "material", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0019", "unit-0021", "unit-0022"], "explanation": "Unit-0020 covers López Obrador's personal attributes and media strategy: his 'pejelagarto' nickname, 'AMLO' acronym, his communicative deficit compared to opponents, his intensive use of the press, and the daily 6am press conferences (mañaneras). The mañaneras are described as generating unusual journalistic expectation and marking the country's political agenda. This is relevant to 5B.7 (publication of economic information; independent evaluation; information practices) and to 5B.1 (communicative approach to policy framing).", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0021", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.1", "5B.6", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "material", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0020", "unit-0022", "unit-0023"], "explanation": "Unit-0021 covers the results of López Obrador's DF government management: vigorous public works campaign, social protection programs including Pensión Universal Alimenticia for older adults, and the PAN opposition's criticism that he was 'populist' and spending DF budget without regard for debt. The budget resistance vs populism characterization is central to 5B.1 and 5B.6. The refusal to implement Seguro Popular is also mentioned as a governance decision.", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0022", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.5", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "pivotal", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0021", "unit-0023", "unit-0024"], "explanation": "Unit-0022 is the opening of the video scandal section (March 2004). It introduces the Televisa broadcast of clandestine video recordings showing prominent PRD politicians and López Obrador's close collaborators — Gustavo Ponce Meléndez (DF Finance Secretary), René Bejarano Martínez (PRD coordinator), and Carlos Ímaz Gispert — engaged in corruption: money laundering, gambling with thousands of dollars in Las Vegas casinos, and negotiating political favors with businessman Carlos Ahumada Kurtz. This is directly relevant to 5B.5 (enforcement against politically connected actors; corruption in procurement).", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0023", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.5", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "pivotal", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0022", "unit-0024", "unit-0025"], "explanation": "Unit-0023 details the aftermath of the video scandal: Rosario Robles's forced departure from PRD leadership, Leonel Godoy's public apologies, the PAN opposition characterization of López Obrador as complicit or willfully ignorant, and López Obrador's counterattack framing the scandal as a 'conspiracy' by Salinas, Fernández de Cevallos, and the Fox government. His delayed and tepid reaction is described alongside the political counterattack strategy. This is directly relevant to 5B.5 (cooperation with courts; corruption enforcement) and 5B.7 (information practices vs political spin).", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0024", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.5", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "material", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0023", "unit-0025", "unit-0026"], "explanation": "Unit-0024 covers the desafuero process initiated by the PGR on May 18, 2004, regarding a land expropriation dispute in Cuajimalpa delegation that began in 2000 under Rosario Robles's DF government. The case involved construction of an access road to a private hospital, court-ordered suspension of works, and the PGR reactivation of the case against López Obrador precisely during the video scandal. This is relevant to 5B.5 (legal enforcement; judicial compliance) and 5B.7 (rule of law vs political targeting narrative).", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0025", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0025 covers the August 2004 demonstration of 200,000 PRD members in the Zócalo supporting López Obrador, the October 2004 presentation of 'Un proyecto alternativo de nación,' the November 2004 removal of Marcelo Ebrard as DF Public Security Secretary by President Fox, and López Obrador's protest and reappointment of Ebrard as Social Development Secretary. The content is primarily about political mobilization and personnel decisions in response to the desafuero. While the desafuero process began here, the substantive description of López Obrador's response and the political escalation continues in units 0026-0027, making this a transitional/introductory chunk.", "exclusion_reason": "Transitional political mobilization unit. Substantive details of desafuero defense, congressional vote, mobilizations, and PGR incapacity are in units 0026-0027. This unit introduces events but does not add independent Chapter 5B economic governance evidence."}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0026", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.5", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "material", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0025", "unit-0027"], "explanation": "Unit-0026 covers the Chamber of Deputies vote on the desafuero (April 7, 2005): 360 votes in favor (PAN and PRI), 127 against (PRD, PT, Convergencia), and 2 abstentions. It describes the civil resistance movement called by López Obrador, the SCJN constitutional dispute, and the legal defense arguments. This is relevant to 5B.5 (institutional compliance; judicial cooperation vs extra-institutional mobilization) and 5B.7 (rule of law framing).", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0027", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.5", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "material", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0026", "unit-0028"], "explanation": "Unit-0027 covers the resolution of the desafuero case: the PGR's inability to get a judge to initiate proceedings emboldened López Obrador (April 25); Fox's political compromise (April 27-28) including accepting the prosecutor's resignation and communicating that López Obrador could contest elections; the May 4 withdrawal of charges by new prosecutor Daniel Cabeza de Vaca; and López Obrador's July 29, 2005 resignation from the DF government to focus on his presidential candidacy. This resolution is relevant to 5B.5 and 5B.7 — both for what it reveals about enforcement cooperation and for the political framing of the outcome.", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0028", "included": true, "relevant_question_ids": ["5B.5", "5B.7"], "relevance_strength": "material", "adjacent_chunk_ids": ["unit-0027", "unit-0029", "unit-0030", "unit-0031", "unit-0032"], "explanation": "Unit-0028 covers the formalization of López Obrador's 2006 presidential candidacy (September 2005 PRD designation; December 10 Zócalo proclamation; January 8, 2006 IFE registration). It includes his differentiation between honest businessmen ('protection and support') vs 'saqueadores y corruptos.' The FOBAPROA and corruption program themes are introduced for the 2006 campaign. This is relevant to 5B.5 (anti-corruption platform; differentiation between connected and non-connected actors) and 5B.7 (public economic framing).", "exclusion_reason": null}, {"schema_version": "chunk_routing_decision_v1", "source_id": "BOOK-013", "source_sha256": "8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80", "chunk_id": "unit-0029", "included": false, "relevant_question_ids": [], "relevance_strength": "none", "adjacent_chunk_ids": [], "explanation": "Unit-0029 covers the 2006 electoral campaign dynamics: Calderón's elitist image, López Obrador's radicalism generating fear among middle classes, the April 2006 debate refusal, López Obrador's nepotism allegations against Calderón regarding BANOBRAS and Energy Ministry, and the 'FeCal' moniker. This is campaign positioning and electoral dynamics content. No executive economic governance.
